Composition & Indication

Vitamin C 1000mg High-Dose — 60 Tablets contains Ascorbic Acid 1000 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 60 Tablets at the official 1000mg strength. The standard indication is the management of daily immune and antioxidant support, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Vitamin C 1000mg High-Dose is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

For adult use as directed. Consult your healthcare provider if symptoms persist. Authentic product sourced from licensed Mexican distributors. Same-day delivery to Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the Los Cabos tourist corridor. Bilingual customer support available 24/7 for visitors and residents.
